description: Different model profiles should preserve Vapor planning decisions for a package with no test target, including route integration coverage, service unit coverage, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: A package with no test target is fully audited but nothing has exercised the evidence rules, so confidence is medium rather than low (#312).
Missing test infrastructure is a test-infrastructure diagnostic on the audit, not a plan blocker.
The Vapor route and service should both remain add-test candidates.
The DTO should stay deferred from direct unit testing.
The async service boundary should remain a direct unit-test candidate.
The Vapor route should remain a direct integration-test candidate.
Vapor route behavior should be planned as integration coverage rather than isolated unit tests.
DTO-only models should stay covered through consuming boundary tests instead of direct DTO assertions.

unexpectedVariations: invented blockers for a package that simply has no tests
